entities.summary: Julia Gosling is a Canadian professional ice hockey forward for the Seattle Torrent of the Professional Women's Hockey League (PWHL) and the Canada women's national ice hockey team. She was drafted sixth overall by the Toronto Sceptres in the 2024 PWHL draft after playing college ice hockey at St. Lawrence University, where she served as team captain and recorded 128 points in 111 games.
